info.title: TV Dashboard Custom GPT Actions
info.description: Compact OAuth façade over tv-dashboard-api (VISTA). Owner of catalog and writes remains TV. Eight Actions under GOVERNED_PREPARE_COMMIT_V2; openapi.json is import-only and not listed here.

get.description: Returns catalogVersion, compact ops index, capabilities, and capability_surface.agent_directives. Full op schemas live in this OpenAPI requestBody. Call before writes; obey agent_directives. Backend authorizes. Requires tv-dashboard.write.

Compact playlist list for the authenticated actor (id/name/role/revision). No coverSlide/nativeConfig. When the actor has a live editor session, editorFocus is returned first (playlistId/slideId/selectedIds, ephemeral TTL).

Playlist context with slides and focused slide. editorFocus omits nativeConfig and returns dataSources + blockIndex. full may auto-downgrade when over budget. objectQuery can return persisted objectMatches. includePreview adds a signed slide preview.

parameters.name: includePreview
parameters.description: When true, include slidePreview with signed previewUrl (schematic PNG). Prefer over a dedicated preview Action.

parameters.name: slideId
parameters.description: Selects focusedSlide (full nativeConfig) and optional includePreview. Defaults to editorFocus.slideId or the first slide.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: full: focusedSlide.nativeConfig + digests. editorFocus: omit nativeConfig; return dataSources[] + blockIndex for existing-object addressability.

parameters.name: objectQuery
parameters.description: Optional filter for objectMatches[] (contentPreview/label/groupId/role). Persisted IDs only.

parameters.name: objectTypes
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated types filter for blockIndex/objectMatches.

parameters.name: blockCursor
parameters.description: Absolute offset cursor for blockIndex pagination.

parameters.name: blockLimit
parameters.description: Max items in blockIndex.items for this page.

get.description: Required NL query over the TV allowlist (owner-local discovery). Never dump the full catalog; never invent operationId. Miss does not prove absence — refine query. Returns compact DTO with paramSchema.

post.summary: Preview a data block without persisting
post.description: Prefer operationId+params from search hits; server validates paramSchema and builds the canonical binding. Legacy block+nativeConfig remains for editor-shaped clients. No persistence.

operationId.description: Preferred shortcut: allowlisted catalog operationId. Server builds canonical binding; do not invent block/nativeConfig.

params.description: Params validated against the route paramSchema (enums/required). Use values from gpt_search_data_routes paramSchema.

block.description: Legacy editor block blob. Prefer operationId+params. Runtime validates downstream when provided.

nativeConfig.description: Legacy editor slide config for dry-run. Optional when operationId is provided.

playlistDefaults.description: Optional playlist dataDefaults blob inherited during dry-run. Route-specific; not a fixed GPT construction contract.

previewOptions.description: Optional resolver flags for dry-run. Intentionally open-ended preview knobs, not a persisted write contract.

post.summary: Suggest typed presentation ops from NL
post.description: Uses the canonical presentation planner. Returns ready|clarification|unsupported|error with typed ops — no free M/SQL. Example: create a playlist named Testando a VISTA.

example.message: Crie uma playlist chamada Testando a VISTA

post.description: PREPARE PresentationMutation compound plan. Server topo-sorts ops (as/playlistRef/slideRef). NO WRITE by default. Additive: commit_now=true + confirmation + Idempotency-Key → PREPARE+COMMIT. Destructive ignores commit_now.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required when commit_now=true (or use body idempotency_key).

ops.description: Typed presentation ops from the canonical TV catalog (objects with op — never bare strings). Shape projected from PresentationOpsContentService.

blockId.description: Alias de identidade do bloco existente (ALTER_EXISTING). Preferir block.id; se informado e o bloco não existir, falha — não cria fantasma.

createIfMissing.description: Quando true, permite criar bloco com id novo/ausente. Padrão seguro: false para text/heading/shape sem frame.

block.description: Smallest semantic block accepted by TvPresentationPatchV1 upsert_block. No resolved/url/mScript. Extra known editor keys may be present and are merged.

textProjection.description: Bind live field onto heading|text|shape: {field, format|displayFormat, aggregation?, prefix?, suffix?, fallback?}. Field must come from data preview/paramSchema.

contentRuns.description: Rich text runs; optional dataRef.field to interpolate live values inside heading/text/shape.

style.description: Optional visual style. For shapes/cards prefer fill+stroke+strokeWidth+borderRadius+boxShadow combo from designTokens.shapeChrome.

kpiProjection.description: KPI field binding. Prefer metrics[].format|displayFormat (number|percent|currency|raw). Never leave empty after bind_visual.

chartOptions.description: ChartStyleOptions: legend, grid, labels, axes, stackMode, sort, topN, density and valueFormat. No free CSS.

chartProjection.description: Chart axes/series binding — do not leave empty after bind_visual.

tableOptions.description: Table presentation knobs (fonts, header, density). Free-form editor blob; prefer set_table_options when available.

dataTransform.description: Prefer set_data_transform; if present must be {steps} only.

operationId.description: Required when creating or changing the route. Optional for label-only patch of an existing blockId.

blockId.description: Existing dataSourceId to patch, or new id when creating.

params.description: Route params as a primitive map. Omit for label-only rename.

label.description: Visible data source name (dataBinding.label). Label-only updates must not change operationId/params/transforms.

sectionRef.description: Alias or authoritative section UUID. Omit to use current section slot.

commit_now.description: If true and confirmationPolicy=direct, PREPARE+COMMIT in one call (requires confirmation + Idempotency-Key). Ignored when policy=confirm.

confirmation.description: Required when commit_now=true (confirmed must be true).

idempotency_key.description: Fallback when Idempotency-Key header is missing. Required for commit_now.

post.description: COMMIT prepared proposal. WRITE. Body: exact proposal_handle + confirmation (+ Idempotency-Key). Never invent handle (no latest). Prefer commit_now on preview for additive direct policies.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key scoped to actor+operation. Atomic acquire before write; same key+payload replays; different payload → 409.

proposal_handle.description: Exact opaque string from gpt_preview_change.proposal_handle. Never invent values like latest/current/null.

oneOf.description: Pass true after explicit user confirmation.

confirmation.description: Explicit user confirmation. Conversational OK is not AuthZ; backend revalidates permission and proposal binding.

idempotency_key.description: Fallback if Idempotency-Key header is omitted.

BearerAuth.description: Keycloak access token for the authenticated human actor.

code.description: Machine code e.g. INVALID_CHANGE, AUTHZ_DENIED, NOT_FOUND, PROPOSAL_CHANGED, PROPOSAL_EXPIRED, PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND, CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, CATALOG_VERSION_STALE, OUTCOME_NOT_VERIFIED, UPSTREAM_FAILURE.

message.description: Human-readable explanation for VISTA to relay.

details.description: Optional diagnostics: operation, opIndex, validationPath, received, expected, internalReason, suggestedCorrection. Never includes tokens, SQL, or stack traces. Intentionally opaque (response-side only).

GptChangeTarget.description: Change target. Omit or leave empty for create_playlist without an existing playlist. playlistId is required by ops that need a playlist.

playlistId.description: Existing playlist UUID when the op requires one.

slideId.description: Slide UUID when the op requires slide context.

GptHostContext.description: Optional editor/host focus. Custom GPT usually omits this; useful when the user already named a playlist/slide in-session.
